spiritgiven.comments: There were instances that hands to our body were used to stop when our cutters try to move and get open, and some marking infractions throughout the game. Spirit Captain and sideline communicated well on adjustments made and apologized right after the game.

spiritreceived.comments: Overall a nice spirited game, both teams got quite competitive as the game became close and we can probably both calm down a bit and focus on being fair during discussions.

For rules knowledge and use, we felt that while some players knew the rules well, it was clear that many were not fully familiar too. It didn’t negatively impact the game, we only wish to note it as a point for improvement. We also commend the Phi team’s effort for constant communication throughout the game. As discussed in the spirit circle, it was one that indeed could’ve gone badly, but we turned it around well, and there are so many takeaways for us. Thank you for the game Philippines!
コールがあった際に、話し合いなくコンテストなった場面があったので、話し合いの姿勢がほしいです。

Overall, it was a very competitive and intense game. 

On communication, there were some difficulty on translation but we felt that calls should be settled by the players themselves and not by others around the field. 

Also, we felt that reactions can sometimes be incredulous and can be more receptive on both perspectives.
コールの時に双方の意見を尊重する姿勢が少し足りないと感じた。

We felt a bit like the discussions were a bit negative and weren’t talked about with an open mind to both peoples perspectives. There was a lot of body hits on deep shots (I know this is hard to control in a competitive game). Hope to see you guys in the finals.

The captains talked about the level of contact before the game but we still felt that there was still significant level of contact before, during and after the play. 

On communication, we felt that players can be calmer and more receptive to calls from both perspective.
事前に話し合った通り、お互いを尊重したフェアな試合ができたと思います。ナイスゲーム！優勝おめでとう！
